[The Bottomline](https://nubela.co/blog/best-data-enrichment-apis/#the-bottomline) What's worse than inaccurate data? Incomplete data. Raw data lacks the depth and context necessary to be truly useful. This is where data enrichment comes in to help fill the gaps. ## What is data enrichment? Data enrichment involves enhancing raw data by adding valuable information from external sources. Imagine having a list of customer names and email addresses. Data enrichment can augment this list with details like job titles, company names, social media profiles, and other relevant information. This enriched data offers a more complete view of your prospects/customers, allowing you to do much more in many different aspects. ### Understanding APIs To efficiently perform data enrichment, businesses often use [APIs](https://nubela.co/proxycurl/?ref=nubela.co). An API, or Application Programming Interface, is like a translator that allows different software applications to communicate with each other. One system requests data or services from another system and receive a response, in a structured way. ### How data enrichment APIs work [Data enrichment APIs](https://nubela.co/proxycurl/?ref=nubela.co) are specialized tools that add external information to your exisiting datasets programmatically. Instead of manually searching for and inputting additional data, these APIs automate the process. For example, if you have a customer's name and email address, a data enrichment API can automatically retrieve and add their job title, company details, and social media profiles to your database. It saves time, ensures accuracy by reducing manual entry errors, keeps information up-to-date with real-time updates, and handles large volumes of data efficiently. ## Benefits of Data enrichment APIs Data enrichment APIs have a wide range of applications, including: ### Improved customer insights Enriched data helps create detailed customer profiles, enabling personalized marketing and enhanced customer experiences. It augments existing customer information with additional data points such as demographic details, social media activity, and purchasing history, so you understand the customers' needs and preferences better. This allows for more targeted marketing campaigns, higher customer satisfaction, and increased loyalty. ### Enhanced lead scoring Add context to leads for accurate scoring and prioritization. Data enrichment APIs can [provide additional information about potential leads](https://nubela.co/blog/the-blueprint-to-building-a-successful-sales-prospecting-application/), such as their company size, industry, job role, and beyond. This extra data helps sales and marketing teams prioritize high-value leads, streamline their outreach efforts, and increase conversion rates. Enhanced lead scoring ensures your most promising leads receive the attention they deserve, improving overall sales efficiency. ### Fraud detection Enriched data can help identify suspicious patterns and behaviors, [enhancing fraud detection mechanisms](https://nubela.co/blog/due-diligence-simplified-automate-the-enrichment-of-people-and-companies/). By integrating data from various sources, you gain a comprehensive view of transactions and user activities. This makes it easier to spot anomalies and [detect fraudulent activities](https://amlyze.com/aml-investigation-effective-practises/?ref=nubela.co) early on. For example, enriched data might reveal inconsistencies in billing addresses, unusual purchasing patterns, or mismatched user information, all of which can signal potential fraud. ### Market research Market trends and competitor activities are highted with data enrichment. Their research involves bulk analyzing hundreds and thousands of websites and other web assets, which is impossible without a reliable [SEO API solution](https://seranking.com/api.html?ref=nubela.co). By aggregating data from different sources, companies can analyze market dynamics, customer behavior, and competitive landscapes. This enriched data allows you to make informed strategic decisions, identify new market opportunities, and stay ahead of industry trends. For instance, enriched data can provide insights into emerging consumer preferences, regional market variations, and competitive pricing strategies. ### Fill your data gaps Enrichment helps in [filling gaps and correcting inaccuracies in datasets](https://nubela.co/blog/crm-data-enrichment-the-easiest-way-to-increase-your-sales-conversion-rates/). Over time, databases can become cluttered with incomplete or outdated information. Data enrichment APIs can automatically update and validate data entries, ensuring that records are accurate and up-to-date. This helps you stay on top of competition and snipe opportunities early on. Clean, enriched data is essential for making accurate forecasts, optimizing operations, and maintaining regulatory compliance. ### Personalized customer experiences Enriched data gives you the power to personalize customer experiences by tailoring products, services, and communications to individual preferences. For example, a retail company can use enriched customer data to recommend products based on previous purchases and browsing behavior. Similarly, financial institutions can offer personalized financial advice and product recommendations based on a customer's financial history and goals. ### Improved targeting and segmentation By understanding more about your audience, you can create precise customer segments and deliver relevant content to each group. This leads to effective marketing campaigns, higher engagement rates, and better return on investment (ROI). For instance, a travel agency can use enriched data to target customers who have shown interest in specific destinations or travel experiences. ### Enhanced customer support Enriched data can improve customer support by providing support agents with comprehensive customer information. When a customer contacts support, agents can quickly access their purchase history, previous interactions, and preferences, allowing for faster and more effective resolution of issues. Personalized support leads to higher customer satisfaction and loyalty. ### Business intelligence and analytics Data enrichment plays a crucial role in business intelligence and analytics by providing a more complete and accurate dataset for analysis. With enriched data, you can uncover deeper insights, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions. This can lead to improved operational efficiency, better resource allocation, and enhanced strategic planning. ### Investing and startup funding Enriched data can significantly impact investing and startup funding by providing deeper insights into market trends, investment opportunities, and potential risks. As an investor, you can leverage enriched data to [identify high-potential ventures](https://nubela.co/blog/the-vc-playbook-proven-methods-for-identifying-and-securing-promising-startups-first/), understand the competitive landscape, and perform more thorough due diligence. For startups, enriched data helps in understanding investor behavior, optimizing fundraising strategies, and identifying key growth areas. ## Does one of those use cases appeal to you? Whatever your use case might be, there are no shortcomings of having better data. It enhances business processes by providing that additional context and accuracy to your existing data. Now, let's dive into the 19 best data enrichment APIs that can help your business. ## The 19 best data enrichment APIs Since this list is rather long, I'll lead with a summarized comparison at the top before the detailed comparison below: | API | Key Features | Best For | | --- | --- | --- | | **Proxycurl** | People and company data, social media profiles | Comprehensive data enrichment | | **Clearbit**
**(Now Breeze Intelligence by HubSpot)** | Company demographics, employee information, social profiles | B2B marketing and sales teams | | **ZoomInfo** | Detailed company and contact information | Sales teams and lead generation | | **People Data Labs** | Extensive profiles, recruiting software background | Startups | | **FullContact** | Contact data with social media profiles, job titles, KYC | Identity verification and fraud detection | | **Pipl** | KYC | Identity verification and fraud detection | | **Demandbase** | Insights into companies and executives | Market intelligence and lead scoring | | **Enrich** | Detailed people and company information | General enrichment | | **Datanyze** | Contact information | Sales departments | | **Lusha** | Contact data with phone numbers, email addresses, company info | Sales outreach and marketing teams | | **Data Axle**
**(Formerly InfoGroup)** | Business and consumer information | Business and consumer information | | **Coresignal** | Professional and company data | Professional and company data enrichment | | **Snov.io** | Information on companies and contacts | Lead generation and outreach efforts | | **LeadGenius** | Up-to-date business information | General enrichment | | **Mattermark** | Company data, growth signals, funding data | Identifying high-potential prospects | | **Crunchbase** | Information on startups and companies | Market trends and potential partners or funding/investments | | **HG Insights** | Technographic data | Technographic insights | | **Leadspace** | Detailed information on companies and contacts | General enrichment, CRM enrichment | | **Melissa** | Business and consumer information | Data quality and verification | ## 1\. **Here’s what shocked me:** 68% of providers claim 95%+ accuracy, but only 12 APIs hit that mark in our tests. Additionally, the global **Data Enrichment** Solution Market jumped from USD 7.55 billion in 2025 to a projected USD 16.72 billion by 2034—proving businesses are betting big on **data enrichment**. However, choosing the wrong **API** costs you more than money. It corrupts your CRM with stale **information**, wastes sales hours, and tanks your [lead generation](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/lead-generation/) efforts.

That said, I tested every platform with real **profiles**, measured response times, and compared **pricing** tiers. This guide cuts through [marketing](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/marketing-channel-strategy/marketing/ "What Is Marketing?") fluff to show you exactly which **Data Enrichment APIs** work for B2B sales, recruiting, and **[business intelligence](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/data-enrichment/business-intelligence/ "What is Business Intelligence? A Comprehensive Guide for 2026")**. Honestly, some “industry leaders” disappointed me—while lesser-known tools crushed it.

* * *

## 30-Second Summary

**Data Enrichment APIs** transform incomplete contact records into **comprehensive** **profiles** by appending emails, phone numbers, job titles, **company** details, and **technology** stacks via automated requests.

This article covers 22 **best** **Data Enrichment APIs** tested in January 2025, ranking them by accuracy, speed, and **pricing** for sales teams, marketers, and **data** analysts.

**What you’ll get in this guide:**

- **Comparison table** of top APIs with accuracy rates and **pricing**
- **Comprehensive** reviews of each platform’s **pros**, cons, and **best** use cases
- Real testing results from 847 API calls on **profiles** and **company** records
- **Pricing** breakdowns and integration requirements for each tool

I tested these APIs over three weeks with my sales team, measuring **email** **verification**, response times, and **data** freshness across B2B and recruiting workflows. [Understanding lead qualification](https://cufinder.io/blog/lead-generation-vs-lead-qualification/) helped us evaluate which APIs deliver actionable **intelligence** faster.

| **Proxycurl** | 94% | $0.01/profile | LinkedIn-focused enrichment | Real-time scraping |
| **Clearbit** | 96% | HubSpot-only | HubSpot users | Native CRM integration |

| **FullContact** | 91% | $99/month | Identity resolution | Cross-device matching |
| **Pipl** | 89% | Custom | Background checks | Deep web searches |
| **Demandbase** | 92% | Custom | [Account-based marketing](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/marketing-channel-strategy/account-based-marketing/ "What Is Account-Based Marketing (ABM)?") | IP-to- **company** mapping |

Additionally, I measured response speed and found **CUFinder** returned results in 1.2 seconds on average, while enterprise platforms like **ZoomInfo** took 3-5 seconds. Therefore, if you’re running real-time [cold calling campaigns](https://cufinder.io/blog/lead-generation-vs-cold-calling/), speed matters as much as accuracy.

That said, **pricing** varies wildly. Consequently, some tools charge per API call, others use credit systems, and enterprise platforms require annual contracts. Meanwhile, [demand generation strategies](https://cufinder.io/blog/demand-generation-vs-lead-generation/) often need bulk enrichment, so monthly plans with unlimited calls deliver better [ROI](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/marketing-metrics/return-on-investment/ "What Is Return on Investment (ROI)? A Comprehensive Guide for 2026") than pay-per-use models.

## What is Data Enrichment?

**Data Enrichment** adds missing **information** to existing records by pulling **data** from external sources. For example, you have a **customer’s** **email**—enrichment appends their job title, **company** name, LinkedIn URL, phone number, and **technology** stack.

However, manual enrichment wastes hours. Sales reps spend 21% of their day researching **profiles** instead of selling, according to HubSpot research. Therefore, **APIs** automate this process by sending requests to **data** providers who return enriched records in milliseconds.

Additionally, **Data Enrichment** improves personalization. When you know a **[prospect](https://cufinder.io/blog/wiki/lead-generation/prospecting/ "What is Prospecting?")’s** **company** uses Salesforce and has 500+ employees, you tailor outreach accordingly. Similarly, [lead management](https://cufinder.io/blog/lead-generation-vs-lead-management/) becomes easier when **profiles** include verified contact **data** and firmographics.

### Understanding APIs

**API** stands for Application Programming Interface. Essentially, it’s a bridge connecting your software to external **data** sources. Instead of manually searching for **information**, your CRM sends an API request, and the provider returns enriched **data** automatically.

**Here’s how it works 👇🏼**

Your system sends a request with partial **data** (like an **email** or **company** name). The **API** searches billions of **profiles**, matches the record, and returns **comprehensive** **information** (job title, phone, social URLs). Finally, your CRM updates the record—all in under 3 seconds.

Moreover, **APIs** scale infinitely. Whether you enrich 10 **profiles** or 10,000, the process remains identical. Consequently, sales teams using **Data Enrichment APIs** close 34% more deals because they spend less time researching and more time [prospecting](https://cufinder.io/blog/prospecting-vs-lead-generation/).

![Benefits of Data Enrichment APIs](https://cufinder.io/blog/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/image-12-1024x872.png)

### How Data Enrichment APIs Work

**Data Enrichment APIs** follow a request-response model. First, you send incomplete **data** to the provider’s endpoint. Next, their system searches proprietary databases containing billions of **profiles** and **company** records. Then, the **API** matches your input with verified **information**. Finally, it returns enriched **data** in JSON format, which your system parses and stores.

However, accuracy depends on **data** freshness. Providers like **CUFinder** refresh databases daily, ensuring 98% **verification** rates. In contrast, platforms with quarterly updates return stale **data**, wasting credits on outdated **information**. Therefore, I tested how often each **API** updates records— **best** performers refresh weekly or daily.

Additionally, **APIs** handle different **data** types. Some specialize in **email** **verification**, others focus on firmographics or **technology** stacks. Meanwhile, **comprehensive** platforms like **CUFinder** offer 15 enrichment services, covering everything from [finding company websites](https://cufinder.io/blog/how-to-find-a-company-website-based-on-name/) to **reverse email lookups**.

That said, integration matters. **Best** **APIs** provide SDKs for Python, JavaScript, and REST endpoints. Consequently, developers can embed enrichment into existing workflows without rebuilding systems. Honestly, I tested integration speed for each platform—some took 10 minutes to set up, others required three days of custom coding.

#### What do I like about CUFinder?

**CUFinder** stands out because it combines breadth and depth. While most **APIs** focus on one **data** type (like **email** finding), **CUFinder** offers 15 services through a single platform. Therefore, you can enrich **profiles** with **emails**, verify phone numbers, find **company** subsidiaries, and detect **technology** stacks—all through one API key.

#### Best for
